title: oven-roasted jasmine peruvian shrimp chupe de camarones
description: a yeasty, fluffy, lazy-sunday peruvian dish featuring jasmine rice, dum, and succulent shrimp
instructions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
in a large wok or frying pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
add the shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through.
remove the shrimp from the wok and set aside.
add the jasmine rice to the wok and stir to coat with oil.
add the chicken broth, aji amarillo pepper, and worcestershire sauce to the wok.
bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the wok.
simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
add the cooked shrimp back to the wok and stir to combine.
serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
